purpose: Transparent Claude Monet-inspired Earth identity for browser tabs. An original generated illustration, not a painting attributed to Monet.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one website favicon and small browser identity icon. Primary request: a single Earth globe painted as an original Claude Monet-inspired impressionist miniature, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Subject: our planet seen from space, with recognizable Africa, Europe and part of Asia, blue oceans, sage-green land and a few soft ivory cloud brushstrokes. Style: confident broken-colour oil brushwork, softly interwoven blue, teal, green, muted ochre and ivory; human, warm and painterly, not a 3D render, emoji or flat vector. Composition: exactly one near-circular globe centered in a square canvas, fully visible, occupying about 92 percent of the width and height. Use large simplified land/ocean masses and a clear rounded silhouette so the Earth remains recognizable at 16 and 32 pixels. Keep the outer silhouette predominantly medium blue/teal so it remains legible on white and near-black browser chrome. Transparent pixels everywhere outside the planet, including all four corners. No background scene, no sky, no stars, no rectangle or tile, no painted paper backdrop, no checkerboard baked into the artwork, no shadow outside the globe, no glow or halo. No text, lettering, border, signature or watermark. Output one square transparent PNG asset, not a presentation mockup or a sheet of icons.

prompts: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: transparent website navigation Earth icon for dark mode. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing Monet-inspired painted Earth. Primary request: create a matching dark-mode edition by changing ONLY its lighting and colour values, not its identity or geography. Keep the same circular silhouette, centered framing, margin, Africa/Europe/Asia viewpoint, continents, cloud shapes, scale, and impressionist oil brushwork. Give it restrained, softly moonlit colour: luminous blue-teal oceans, sage/soft ochre land, subdued pearly clouds. Keep enough midtone lightness and a clear blue edge to read at 32px against near-black #0c0a09, without bright white glare. This is still the same visible Earth, not a dark hemisphere or night-city satellite view. Genuine transparent RGBA background outside the globe; preserve transparent corners. No background colour, sky, stars, checkerboard, glow, halo, drop shadow, border, lettering, signature, new elements, or mockup. Single square PNG artwork.

Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the edit target. Remove the entire checkerboard background outside the painted Earth and export an actual transparent RGBA PNG cutout with an alpha channel. The previous file accidentally had a painted gray-white checkerboard; every pixel of that background must now be truly transparent (alpha zero), not replaced with white, black, grey, or another drawn pattern. Preserve the globe itself unchanged: same centered position, circular shape, size, Africa-Europe-Asia geography, dark-mode blue/teal/ochre painterly colours and brushwork. Keep the square canvas and the existing thin margin. Change only the background to genuine transparency. Clean anti-aliased edges, no halo, no new scene, no new elements, no text.
